newsitem.title: GERMANY: Waigel says U.K. role in EMU would be best.
newsitem.headline: Waigel says U.K. role in EMU would be best.

text.p: Britain's participation in European economic and monetary union (EMU) would be of benefit to both Europe and Britain, German Finance MInister Theo Waigel said on Friday.

"Britain will decide for itself whether to take part in EMU, but it would be good for Europe and Britain if it takes part," Waigel told a news conference at the party headquarters of his Christian Social Union (CSU).
Waigel says U.K. role in EMU would be best
Asked about the implications for the euro of the British Labour party landslide victory in Thursday's elections, Waigel said he did not wish to interfere in the country's domestic politics.
He said however that the anti-EMU line taken by the Tories had not paid off.
Waigel said in recent years he had had good cooperation with the likely British Chancellor of the Exchequer Gordon Brown, and said he struck him as interested in fiscal stability.
